data.auth_url: Auth host (leave blank to use base_url — set to https://cas-eu.epcube.com for real cloud)
data.session_cookie: JSESSIONID cookie (paste from browser DevTools; required for real cloud)
data.username: Username (mock only — leave blank for real cloud)
data.password: Password (mock only — leave blank for real cloud)
data.dev_id: Device ID (optional — auto-picked if account has one device)
data.sg_sn: Device serial sgSn (optional — auto-picked if account has one device)

error.no_auth_supplied: Provide either a JSESSIONID cookie (real cloud) or username + password (mock)
error.invalid_auth: Authentication rejected — cookie expired or credentials wrong
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the cloud API at the supplied base URL
error.no_devices: Account is reachable but no devices are registered
error.multiple_devices: Multiple devices found — supply dev_id or sg_sn to disambiguate
error.unknown: Unexpected error — check Home Assistant log
